frontmatter.title: Ground the first causal life-to-represented-actor boundary

comment: 2026-10-07 source-grounded origin-contract refinement on reviewed planning head e2d6893, same existing Incoming3 design owner. Recovered simulation-methods-research explicitly allows conditions-driven sub-grid life origin; first-principles abiogenesis is not a prerequisite. Current planet mass times elemental carbon fraction supplies a coarse upper bound, not accessible substrate. Select a concrete proposed finite parent-local account/transaction interface and one conservative, versioned origin allocation rule using actual composition and natural ecology conditions. Distinguish aggregate carbon, habitat allocation, accessible substrate and living stock; organics includes bound oxygen and is not kgC. Select routine numeric/identity/order/atomic-owner decisions, retain uncertainty/calibration limits, and size producer/materializer integration from the finished contract. Never repeatedly mint stock from normalized biomass, phase resets or zoom; explicitly name authority after admission and parent-loss/boundary-update accounting. Preserve prior research, full proposal provenance and later individual/Gate requirements. No production change, biological parameter validity claim, board admission or gameplay acceptance. This refines the existing spec; no new planning owner or user decision is required merely to choose routine engineering mechanisms.
